title: Refusal after N = 3 expired attempts, entered atomically, no receipt
scenario: Three attempts each expire without an anchor confirmed in window (calendar outage, fee spike). The final expiry enters the refusal; nothing ships afterwards.

mutations.detail: OTS calendars unreachable (or never confirming) for 3 x (delta + slack)

choices: Lifecycle clock: wall time with slack S = 24 h (clock-precedence ruling); the model's single clock is fused. The refusal record's content (A3.7.2 extended atomic entry) is unmodelled (PROPERTIES row A3.7.2 open), so only 'no receipt, refused, latched' is expected.

needs: Calendar fault injection and a compressible clock in a staging issuer (real time would be about 3 x 96 h). The registered 20 Nov 'bounded local refusal' item is the place to run it.

staging_harness.harness: staging issuer with an OTS calendar fault switch, a compressible lifecycle clock, the attempt log, and a durable refusal record
sequence: S1 calendars unreachable; submit request R at W = d
S2 advance W past attempt 1's expiry (DELTA + slack); observe expiry and the start of attempt 2
S4 after attempt 3 expires, observe the refusal
S5 restore calendar availability and deliver late evidence that would confirm attempt 3's anchor in window
S6 advance W and poll; restart the issuer process; poll again
observations: O1 exactly three attempts, each expired at its own W_exp (attempt counter 1, 2, 3)
O2 the refusal is entered once, at attempt 3's expiry, atomically with the final discard (no state between)
O3 after S5 and S6 the request R stays refused: no receipt is ever returned and no attempt 4 starts
O4 the refusal survives the restart (latched)

controls.expect: attempt 2 ships; no refusal is entered (RefusedOnlyWhenExhausted)
no refusal and no expiry: distinguishes a latched refusal from a stalled issuer

staging_harness.test_oracle_limit: No TEST issuer recipe: issue.py has no attempts, clock or refusal latch.

status_note: requires staging harness; not exercisable through the public API alone
